niche_preference_profile: Prefers clean, structured interfaces with strong hierarchy, clear section containment, and restrained visual clutter. Generally favors light neutral backgrounds with soft purple or muted accents, high text legibility, and balanced open spacing, though they also show a specific secondary preference for warm charcoal dark themes when paired with centered headers, compact overlays, and anchored bottom navigation. Likes card-based grouping, concise but sufficiently informative content, clearly labeled actions, and subtle integrated iconography over oversized or decorative graphics.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers layouts with obvious section structure, strong headings/labels, clear grouping of content, and actions that are easy to prioritize.
Prefers light neutral backgrounds, soft gray surfaces, and soft purple or muted accents over darker, higher-contrast, neon, or heavily saturated themes.
Prefers minimal compositions with fewer competing elements, generous breathing room, and reduced overlays or decorative extras.
Prefers card-based containment, aligned grids, divided rows, and clearly bounded sections rather than loose or weakly structured layouts.
Prefers high-contrast text, readable light surfaces, visible labels, and clearer text presentation over lower-contrast or placeholder-only labeling.
Prefers interfaces that stay compact and simplified but still include enough useful detail, guidance, and status information to feel complete.
Prefers subtle, integrated icons and calm control treatments, with clearly labeled actions when needed, over oversized icons, floating decorative elements, or overly flashy controls.
